name: Demon Slayer Quest Month combat lamp
observed_restrictions: Jagex lists two combat lamps each granting 1,000 XP, claimed from Aris after the quest. Seven conventional combat skills, base level 1 and retention are draft assumptions consistent with the existing Black Knights' Fortress lamp model; they are not independently verified.

evidence.note: One selectable combat skill per lamp. The publisher did not specify skill level gates, retention or the exact skill set. Record these as assumptions pending in-game confirmation.
